personal.dosimeter.title: DOSIMETER · RADIATION ON THE SURFACE OF MARS
personal.dosimeter.context: Measured outside (Gale crater). The base, buried under the regolith (Mars' blanket of rock and sand), gets much less radiation.
personal.dosimeter.source: Real data: NASA OSDR RadLab · MSL RAD (Curiosity rover) · record {day} · downloaded {retrieved}
personal.dosimeter.replay: Replay of a real record, not live data.
personal.dosimeter.no_data: No radiation data. Run: npm run data:radlab
personal.sun.explain: A CME is a giant cloud of particles thrown out by the Sun. Your base, protected under the Martian regolith, shields you from its radiation.
personal.health.title: ASTRONAUT HEALTH · REAL STUDIES
personal.health.where.radiation_immunity: human cells in microgravity (almost no gravity in orbit)
personal.health.osd924: In space, muscles and bones get weaker, especially on long missions.
personal.health.osd343: The body changes: mitochondria (the cells' «batteries») and the day-night clock work differently.
personal.health.osd812: NK defender cells attacked sick cells much worse. That is why protecting yourself from radiation matters so much.
personal.health.source: Source: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) · retrieved {date} · record, not live
personal.health.no_data: No health studies (run: npm run data:osdr)
personal.sep.exposed: Time outside the shelter at the worst: {min} min
personal.sep.real: REAL profile: storm of 20/05/2024 measured by Curiosity (NASA OSDR RadLab).
personal.sep.nasa: NASA biological limits: 250 mSv per storm · 600 mSv over a space career (1 mSv = biological damage of 1,000 µSv).
personal.dosimeter.info_unit: µGy/h (micrograys per hour): measures the physical radiation absorbed. The sievert (mSv) measures the real biological damage to the human body. Outside now: {rate} µGy/h.
personal.sep.go: Go to the water shelter in the crew quarters!
personal.sep.safe: You are protected in the shelter
personal.sep.ending: The worst is over: you can come out
personal.sun.info_gst: Geomagnetic storm: a CME cloud hits Earth's magnetic field and makes auroras. Mars has almost no global magnetic field, so there the regolith protects you.
personal.sun.info_sep: Particle storm (SEP): very fast protons from the Sun that arrive within minutes or hours. These are the ones that send you to the shelter.
personal.health.tip.muscle_bone: Without gravity they lose mass: daily exercise is needed
personal.health.info_note: Simplified summaries for all ages. Full title and data at osdr.nasa.gov.
personal.shelter.title: SHELTER
personal.shelter.info_1: Water has lots of hydrogen. Light nuclei slow down the Sun's particles without making as much secondary radiation as heavy metals do.
personal.shelter.info_2: That is why storm shelters surround the crew with water, food and equipment. In the game only the bunk alcove lined with water tanks protects you: get inside it.
personal.shelter.info_3: The base is also under the regolith (Mars' natural blanket of soil and rock), which acts as a shield against cosmic rays.
personal.shelter.info_note: General outreach: qualitative explanation, not measured in this base.
